name: session-management
description: Keeps a session's user-given name alive where Claude Code drops it: hooks re-apply the name badge and the live session-registry entry after /clear and /rename, so every registry reader keeps reporting the right name. Logs each named session's exit (name, folder, timestamp, id) to a history file, ships a resume picker that reopens any past named session in its own folder, and adds /session-management:session-handoff to compact the current session into <project>/handoff/<session-name>-NNN.md.
